findings.reason: The original standalone tile has no illustration. A concrete image-plane drawing materially clarifies the two opposite-opening parabola families, the exceptional axis rays, and orthogonality at a noncritical crossing; this is warranted despite the complete algebraic verification.
findings.action: Added a fenced TikZ illustration and explanatory caption in final Remarks.

correction: Appended Remarks with representative image parabolas for |c|,|d| in {1,sqrt(2)}, the axis-image rays, critical value 0, and perpendicular tangents at 2i. Existing title, statement, facts, verification and all frontmatter are byte-identical.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_map: f:C -> C, f(z)=z^2; image coordinates (u,v). Diagram is in the codomain; it does not assert global injectivity.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Given and verification step 1.1 give u=x^2-y^2 and v=2xy.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Blue plots u=1-v^2/4 and u=2-v^2/8 correspond respectively to c^2=1 and 2; orange plots u=v^2/4-1 and u=v^2/8-2 correspond to d^2=1 and 2.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Steps 2.1 and 2.2. Changing c or d to its negative leaves these eliminated equations unchanged; all nonzero families are parabolas with the drawn opposite openings.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Blue nonpositive real ray is x=0; orange nonnegative real ray is y=0. Arrowheads point outward to indicate continuation, not parameter orientation.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Zero cases in steps 2.1 and 2.2 give (-y^2,0) and (x^2,0). The origin has f(0)=0 and f'(0)=0 by L1 and step 3.1.

diagram_math_checks.relation: At z=1+i, f(z)=2i=(0,2); the c=d=1 image parabolas intersect there. Dashed tangent directions (1,1) and (1,-1) have dot product zero; the square marker has perpendicular adjacent segments.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Differentiating the step-1.1 vertical parameterization at y=1 gives (-2,2), and the step-2.2 horizontal parameterization at x=1 gives (2,2). These span the two dashed lines. Their orthogonality also follows from step 1.2 and L2 since 2z is nonzero.
